t: Chapter 3: As we continued north through the desert, the looming hills and mountains promised blessed relief from the seemingly never-ending sand. Soon we got to the end of the foothills, and we decided to rest there for the night. As tired as I was of marching across the sand, I felt strangely afraid. I had lived my entire life in the sands; they were my home, and the rocky hills and white glistening mountaintops seemed foreign and foreboding.

I worried if I was doing the right thing, leading my people to strange lands. Despite Eloh’s promises, I was not as confident as Zhul was that it would all end well. Looking back I thought it strange that I was the one that Eloh showed herself to. I was never particularly devout, always worried more about day to day matters than the other-worldly ones. But who was I to question a god?

That night, as I slept, I dreamt again, for the first time since that first fateful night. Eloh came to me again, and this time she appeared in a vision as a beautiful glowing figure, as bright as the suns. She said “Have courage, for though soon you shall go through a time of darkness, all your trials shall be richly rewarded in the end. You must go under the northern mountains, not over them. You will find the ruins of an ancient watch tower made of black obsidian in the desert by the edge of the hills. By that tower you will find the entrance to the tunnels you seek. Follow the smooth ancient tunnel down under the mountains and when you again see the sky and my suns, I shall contact you. But beware those who lurk in the darkness, they hide from my light, and must not be trusted. I have no power in the dark, so you are my hand of justice. Punish the non-believers. Go now, and fear not the dark.” And again, just like before, I was woken up by a shout in the night.
You lose control (even temporarily) of more than 6 villages
Kaleh, wake up! Sentries report movement in the sands!
You think you can take me, Azkotep?
My champion, Zur shall slice you to shreds like the puny adept you once were.
You always were an arrogant little bastard. Grak will swallow your soul, or what’s left of it.
You spurned me once and I will make you pay. To battle, my minions! Become my wrath!
... think so. You really know how to pick a campsite, Kaleh.
Where did they come from? I swear those castles weren’t there at sunset.
Many strange things can happen during the long dark. But despite their wraith-like forms, I have no doubt that their cold steel can still bite flesh.
Like I haven’t killed enough undead recently. Why can’t these creeps just stay dead?
Our encampment is out of the direct line of attack, so we should be somewhat safe, at least.
But if the battle spills around our people will be slaughtered by the undead hordes!
There’s no way we can escape the battle in time. We must protect the camp from the undead.
I fear that if we lose more than half of the tents we will not have the strength to go on. Garak, wake your men. We must hold off the undead until dawn.
To arms my people, to arms!
They’re raising the corpses of our fallen! What a horrible fate!
Then we shall have to give them a proper cremation.
Too many of our people have been killed. We will surely be overwhelmed by the undead now. All is lost!
These champions... I will challenge them. Zhul, bless my weapons with light of Eloh.
You will not do any such thing, anyone trying to fight these creeps singlehanded will surely die. We need you, we will not make it without you.
I had a dream this night Kaleh, full of gloom and darkness. My journey will end here one way or another.
No! That’s not true, our future is what we make of it, stay behind for this fight and...
And what? You’ll help me become a coward? I lived long, I’m not afraid of the end, just let me give it some meaning.
I bless you with the light that will come, I bless you with the memory and the promise. Lay down your shield, champion, and let your blade shine in the dark.
Garak’s resistances are increased by 20% when defending.
If used offensively or defensively against champions Grak or Zur, this attack presses the engagement until one of the combatants is slain, or 30 rounds of attacks have occurred.
This attack always has a 70% chance to hit regardless of the defensive ability of the champion being attacked.
You there! Creep! Stand and face me, shade! I challenge you!
Foolish mortal... For daring to challenge me, I’ll devour your soul and torment it for all eternity...
So you destroyed Zur... Come mortal, let’s cross our blades... It’s time for you to take his place...
You there! Pile of bones! I challenge you, stand and face me!
Grak was weak... But still you deserve respect... Meet my axe and take his place...
And so it ends... Your champion is dead, elves... Come join him...
Where is Garak? Has anybody seen him?
I saw him jumping into deep darkness pursuing a group of enemies. Let’s hope nothing happened to him.
No! This contest is not over yet, Ystara. I shall show you a taste of my true power.
No! This contest is not over yet, Azkotep. I shall show you a taste of my true power.
Eloh protect us, what has he done?
I live again! I can feel!
I will... not... yield... I defeated... your... champion... I... will... overcome... you...
The dark lord... is no more...
Garak collapses to the ground with his own blade sticking from his chest.
No! How dare you? I shall have my vengeance upon you for spoiling this contest! Darkness shall reign until I have triumphed!
Eloh protect us, what is happening?
I live again! I can feel!
Hahaha! Your puny friend is no more. With his body I shall crush you all. Arise again my minions and feast in the slaughter!
No, I shall have my revenge. I shall show you that darkness is strongest just before dawn. Death and decay, grant me my vengeance!
In this I shall support you, the darkness will not lift until one of us is victorious.
I told you, I will be back, you fools! Now I shall have my vengeance upon you all. Darkness shall reign until I have triumphed!
In this I shall support you, the darkness shall not lift until one of us is victorious.
Look, dawn is nigh, our salvation is almost at hand. Even the long dark can’t last forever, and with the light of the sun the undead power wanes and their dark magics unravel.
Maybe I spoke too soon. Curse Uria, he has even blotted out the stars, all is darkness. Kaleh, our course is clear, we must destroy that abomination.
But to kill Garak? How can we?

That thing is not Garak. This night has lasted long enough, and too many of our people have died. How many more would you sacrifice for Garak’s sake? Just protecting our encampments isn’t enough, darkness and chaos will overwhelm us if we can’t end this battle soon. We must destroy one of those two evils, whatever the cost. I do not intend to let that... thing keep control of the body of our friend.
The stench of death is in the air.
Yes, let us end this once and for all.
What’s this on our borders? Stinkin’ elves and more undead? We’ll teach them a lesson they won’t soon forget. Attack!
If those raiders capture any of our encampments, I fear our people’s fate will be just as bad as if it was captured by the undead.
Orcs... Not far behind me... From the hills...
You got me, elf... But you won’t be so lucky with the tribes of the hills... (Cough)
I deeply regret... I won’t be able to see that...
Look, he dropped something! I wonder what it is...
It’s some sort of a map. I think I recognize some of those hills ahead on it.
And these look like camps and patrol routes. A lot of camps and patrol routes. Kaleh, do you think we could sneak up between them?
Difficult, but worth a try I guess. But first we must try to survive this mess.
And now we’ll never know what was on that parchment. Shame.
You think you have defeated me, don’t you? Foolish boy, I shall assume a new form more powerful and horrible than you could ever imagine!
How dare you interfere in our contest! I did not need your help. I shall teach you not to cross a lord of darkness.
See, I told you I was more powerful. This game is over, now I can leave this shell of a body.
Protect the boy for me Zhul, (cough) I go to a better place.
I’ve asked and looked around, there is no sign of him or his body
He’s probably dead, then, but he died as a warrior. Let’s respect his wishes and remember him for that.
He died as a hero. Remember that and tell the tale, for it’s worth it.
The undead lords are defeated at last.
There’s too many of them and the night is almost gone. Pull back you wretches, pull back!
I can see the first rays of Naia shining over the horizon. She never looked so beautiful. The undead forces have crumbled into dust and the remaining orcs are retreating with the dawn.

That was a very brave thing you did, Kaleh, defeating both of those Undead Lords. It took great courage and strength. Because of your daring attack, we did not have to wait for the dawn to save us. You were our savior. And many fewer of our people died than would have if we had had to wait out the long night.

Though we saved almost all our people this time, we won’t always be so lucky. While elves who have fought with you in the past will gladly return, if the numbers of our people dwindle, it’s going to become more and more costly to recruit new warriors. It would be wise to stockpile gold against this eventuality.

You have triumphed for the moment, but think not that the dark lords can be so easily vanquished. We shall return, and shall rule long after your bones have crumbled to dust. This is our land, and none shall leave it unscathed.
You fought so hard to protect your precious people, young elf. No great deed should go unpunished.
A token to remember us by...
Protect the boy for me Zhul, (cough) I go to a better place.
You will never see your champion again. And we will torment his soul for the rest of the eternity.
Don’t listen to them, they are powerless in their defeat. Even if Garak fell in battle his soul went to a better place and they can’t reach him there.
Hah, now you have learned the flesh is always weaker than the powers of the undead.
My undead zombies shall always defeat the living.
Protect the boy for me Zhul, (cough) I go to a better place.
From the sands he came, to the sands he will return. We remember and honor his sacrifice, and I vow that his death will not be in vain.
Goodbye, old friend. May Eloh shine her light eternal upon you.
He was as brave and valiant a fighter as I have ever seen in my travels.
He was a bastard at times... But... but why did he have to die? It... it just doesn’t make sense.
Miraculously, all of our encampments survived the night.

Though we saved almost all our people this time, we won’t always be so lucky. While elves who have fought with you in the past will gladly return, if the numbers of our people dwindle, it’s going to become more and more costly to recruit new warriors. It would be wise to stockpile gold against this eventuality.
Well, only $elven_camps encampments remain, but we will survive.

Though we saved almost all our people this time, we won’t always be so lucky. While elves who have fought with you in the past will gladly return, as the numbers of our people dwindle, it’s going to become more and more costly to recruit new warriors. It would be wise to stockpile gold against this eventuality.

We have suffered losses, but we are not broken yet. We have saved most of our people tonight. But while elves who have fought with you in the past will gladly return, as the numbers of our people dwindle, it’s going to become more and more costly to recruit new warriors. It would be wise to stockpile gold against this eventuality.

We have suffered grievous losses, but we are not broken yet. Long will this slaughter be remembered by our people. Where was Eloh during the darkness? And I’m afraid that while elves who have fought with you in the past will gladly return, as the numbers of our people dwindle, it’s going to become more and more costly to recruit new warriors. It would be wise to stockpile gold against this eventuality.
All this death and destruction. What were those shades arguing over? Was this all just some sort of demented game?
The lords of the dead are powerful and twisted indeed. Only Eloh knows the truth of what happened tonight.
I don’t want to be here tomorrow night to find out. The hills to the north are close. Let’s be far away before another nightfall.
I’m too young to die. What will happen to my people?
Eloh protect us, I have fallen.
I go now to join my forefathers...
Without his guidance, how can we escape from these infernal caves? We are lost without him!
He was a brave warrior and a true ally. He will be missed.
Farewell Nym, I go to the sea god. You elves must go on without me.
Farewell Esanoo. You were my favorite of the merfolk.
This can’t be the end, I have too much left to see.
How could we have let her die? I’ve never seen fire magic like that before. She will be sorely missed.

t: This attack always has a 70% chance to hit regardless of the defensive ability of the unit being attacked.
This unit has magical attacks, which always have a high chance of hitting an opponent.

This unit has magical attacks, which always have a high chance of hitting an opponent.
Strong units do 1 more damage for every successful strike in melee combat, and have 1 additional hitpoint.

While useful for any close-combat unit, strong is most effective for units who have a high number of swings such as the elvish fighter. Strong units can be very useful when a tiny bit of extra damage is all that is needed to turn a damaging stroke into a killing blow.
Quick units have 1 extra movement point, but 5% less hitpoints than usual.

Quick is the most noticeable trait, particularly in slower moving units such as trolls or heavy infantry. Units with the quick trait often have greatly increased mobility in rough terrain, which can be important to consider when deploying your forces. Also, quick units aren’t quite as tough as units without this trait and are subsequently less good at holding contested positions.
Intelligent units require 20% less experience than usual to advance.

Intelligent units are very useful at the beginning of a campaign as they can advance to higher levels more quickly. Later in campaigns Intelligent is not quite as useful because the After Maximum Level Advancement (AMLA) is not as significant a change as advancing a level. If you have many ‘maximum level’ units you may wish to recall units with more desirable traits.
Resilient units have an additional 4 hitpoints, and gain 1 more per level.

Resilient units can be useful at all stages of a campaign, and this is a useful trait for all units. Resilient is often most helpful as a trait when it occurs in a unit that has some combination of low hitpoints, good defense, or high resistances. Resilient units are especially useful for holding strategic positions against opponents.
